helpMessage:
\`{binary} -h\`: to show this menu
\`{binary} peak\`: to generate a message/image with the peak of the day
\`{binary} -o peak\`: to generate a message/image with the highest peak
\`{binary} -c peak\`: to generate a message/image with the current people
\`{binary} -t <theme_name> peak\`: to generate a message/image with a specific theme
\`{binary} -t <theme_name> -c peak\`: to generate a message/image with a specific theme with the current people
\`{binary} -t <theme_name> -o peak\`: to generate a message/image with a specific theme with the highest peak
